title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Main guide for natural persons for the 2025 return: income, deductions, wealth, securities schedule, tariff mechanics (Vollsplitting, einfache Steuer times Steuerfuss).
notes: 50 pages, cover footer 01.26, last page HA (2025) 12.25. Page 4 is the Kurzübersicht of 2025 amounts; pages 5 and 9 describe E-Tax SG and the rules for printouts from private software; page 50 explains Vollsplitting and the Gesamtsteuerfuss. The filing deadline is not printed in the guide: it refers to the date on page 1 of the personal return.

title: Kurzübersicht Wegleitung 2025
why_needed: One-page table of the 2025 caps and flat rates (commuting, meals, professional cost flat rate, pillar 3a, childcare, party donations, social deductions), with changes from 2024 in bold italics.
notes: 1 page, created 18 Dec 2025. Same table as page 4 of the guide. Each row gives the guide page. Text extraction mangles the header; read the PDF.

title: Merkblatt 32: Merkblatt für die Direkte Bundessteuer 2025
why_needed: Lists where the federal tax differs from the cantonal rules on the same SG return, with a federal tariff extract on the back.
notes: 2 pages. PDF created 25 Mar 2026, so it was re-issued during the filing season. Use the federal (ch) sources for the federal tariff itself.

title: Merkblatt 8: Unterjährige Steuerpflicht zufolge Wegzugs ins Ausland sowie bei Tod im Jahr 2026
why_needed: Only 2026 guidance published so far; section 11 lists the rule changes from 2025 to 2026 (gaming thresholds, car mileage rate, retroactive pillar 3a purchases, childcare, education and party donation caps).
notes: 4 pages, footer 01.26, created 5 Nov 2025. Listed on sg.ch as 08 - Ergänzung Wegleitung 2026 under 2026 unterjährige Formulare. Covers only liability ending in 2026, but section 11 applies to the full 2026 year too. Full-year 2026 Wegleitung not published as of 2026-10-13.

title: Steuererklärung für natürliche Personen 2025 (Formular 1)
why_needed: Main 2025 return form (cantonal, communal and federal tax), 4 pages, with the Ziffer numbering the guide follows.
notes: Form code HA (2025) 12.25. Blank copy: the personal filing deadline, register number and access code are printed only on the copy mailed to each taxpayer.

title: Wertschriften- und Guthabenverzeichnis, Rückerstattungsantrag Verrechnungssteuer 2025 (Formular 2)
why_needed: Securities and bank balances schedule with the withholding tax refund claim; mandatory for every taxpayer together with Formular 1.
notes: 2 pages, form code HA (2025) 12.25. Rubrik A is for income from which Verrechnungssteuer was deducted. Crypto assets are also declared here (sg.ch Kryptowährungen page).

title: Berufskosten 2025 (Formular 4)
why_needed: Employee professional costs: commuting (public transport, bicycle, car with reasons), meals, flat rate for other costs, weekly stay, side income; Person 1 on the front, Person 2 on the back.
notes: 2 pages, form code HA (2025) 12.25. The caps and flat rates are printed in the form; not copied here. Annual flat rates under Ziffer 3 and 5 are prorated for partial-year liability.

title: Schuldenverzeichnis, Freiwillige Zuwendungen / Parteispenden 2025 (Formular 5)
why_needed: Private debts at 31 Dec 2025 with interest paid (front), and charitable donations and party donations (back).
notes: 2 pages, form code HA (2025) 12.25. Receipts are filed only on request.

title: Versicherungsprämien und Sparzinsen; Krankheits-, Unfall- und behinderungsbedingte Kosten 2025 (Formular 6)
why_needed: Insurance premiums and savings interest deduction (three steps: actual premiums, cap, net) and medical costs above the deductible threshold on the back.
notes: 2 pages, form code HA (2025) 12.25. sg.ch lists it as 06 - Versicherungsprämien / Krankheitskosten 2025.

title: Liegenschaften 2025 (Formular 7)
why_needed: One form per property: rental value, rents, maintenance and administration costs. Only needed for owners.
notes: 2 pages, form code HA (2025) 12.25. A separate 07Z summary form exists for several properties (same folder, Formular_7Z_NP_2025_HA.pdf), not added.

title: Ausbildungskosten Kinder / Kinderbetreuungskosten (Formular 10)
why_needed: Year-independent schedule for children's education costs (Ziffer 10.01) and third-party childcare costs (10.02), with a Steuerperiode field to fill in.
notes: 2 pages, fillable eForm, last modified Feb 2022. Listed on sg.ch under Jahresunabhängige Formulare. Caps are in the guide, not on the form.

title: Tarif 2025
why_needed: Table of the einfache Steuer on income (single tariff, Vollsplitting for couples and single parents) and the flat einfache Steuer on wealth for 2025.
notes: 105 pages, created 30 Sep 2025 from Tarif 2025 SG Def.xlsx. Page 1 states the rounding rules, the top flat-rate threshold for singles and for couples, and that the couple rate is the single rate on half the income rounded down to 100 francs. Amounts are einfache Steuer at 100 percent; multiply by the Steuerfüsse.

title: Tarif 2026
why_needed: 2026 income and wealth tariff (einfache Steuer), same structure as 2025 with indexed brackets.
notes: 105 pages, created 26 Mar 2026. Page 1 has the same rules as 2025 with a slightly higher top threshold. Matches StG Stand 1.1.2026 Art. 50 (changed 2025-044, in force 1.1.2026).

title: StB 6 Nr. 1: Kantonssteuerfuss in Prozenten der einfachen Steuer
why_needed: Official history of the cantonal multiplier (Staatssteuerfuss) from 1975 to 2026, including 2025 and 2026.
notes: 1 page, Stand 01.01.2026 (replaces 01.01.2025). The canton's rate is also printed in the header of each yearly Steuerfüsse PDF. The sg.ch link ends in .pdf.ocFile/006_1.pdf and redirects here.

title: Steuerfüsse der Gemeinden des Kantons St. Gallen im Jahr 2025
why_needed: Every political commune's multiplier and Grundsteuer rate, the Catholic and Protestant church multipliers per Kirchgemeinde, and the combined canton plus commune plus church total.
notes: 4 pages, created 15 Jan 2026 (final version). Header states the cantonal multiplier, the statewide Christkatholisch church rate, and footnotes on Zentralsteuer included in church rates and on Kirchgemeinden straddling communes. Some communes (e.g. St. Gallen) are split into several church areas.

title: Steuerfüsse der Gemeinden des Kantons St. Gallen im Jahr 2026
why_needed: 2026 multipliers for every commune and church community, same layout as 2025.
notes: 4 pages, PDF created 30 Sep 2026 (file name says für Versand). Columns: Grundsteuersatz in Promille, Gesamtsteuerfuss of the political commune, Catholic and Protestant church rates, and total canton plus commune per confession. An interactive per-commune lookup exists at sg.ch (Steuerfuss-Übersicht aller SG-Gemeinden) but is not a file.

title: StB 39 Nr. 3: Fahrt zum Arbeitsort
why_needed: Practice on the commuting deduction: history of the cap (GA link dropped by the XXII. Nachtrag), car use conditions, company car, mileage rate.
notes: 6 pages, Stand 01.01.2026 (replaces 01.01.2025); the 15. Nachtrag list says the mileage rate was adjusted. Read with Formular 4 for the year.

title: StB 39 Nr. 8: Auswärtige Verpflegung
why_needed: Conditions for the meal deduction (employment, break length, canteen discount, shift work, each working spouse).
notes: 4 pages, Stand 01.07.2021. Use the yearly Formular 4 for the amounts.

title: StB 48 Nr. 1: Kinderabzug
why_needed: Cantonal child deduction rules (pre-school versus in school or education, shared custody, adult children in education); differs from the federal rule.
notes: 11 pages, Stand 01.01.2021. Any amounts in it may predate later law changes: take the yearly amounts from the guide. StB 48 Nr. 2 (Familienkonstellationen) has the overview table, not added.

title: StB 45 Nr. 14: Kinderbetreuungskosten
why_needed: Conditions for the third-party childcare deduction (children under 14, same household, link to work or education).
notes: 3 pages, Stand 01.01.2021. The cap it quotes is outdated: the 2025 guide and the 2026 Merkblatt 8 give higher caps. Use it for conditions only.

title: StB 45 Nr. 9: Beiträge an die gebundene Selbstvorsorge (Säule 3a)
why_needed: Pillar 3a deduction practice under BVV3 (who may contribute, with or without second pillar, couples, end of employment).
notes: 13 pages, Stand 01.01.2025. The sg.ch index links it as 045_9.pdf.html, which redirects to this PDF. The retroactive 3a purchase deductible from the 2026 return is described in Merkblatt 8 section 11, not here.

title: StB 46 Nr. 4: Freiwillige Zuwendungen für öffentliche oder ausschliesslich gemeinnützige Zwecke
why_needed: Donation deduction: eligible recipients, minimum per year and cap as a share of net income (Art. 46 Bst. c StG, same as federal Art. 33a DBG).
notes: 4 pages, Stand 01.07.2021. The list of tax-exempt St.Gallen institutions is on sg.ch (Zuwendungen an gemeinnützige Organisationen), file name changes with each update.

title: Steuergesetz vom 9. April 1998 (sGS 811.1), Stand 1. Januar 2026
why_needed: Cantonal tax law in force from 1 Jan 2026: Steuerfuss (Art. 5 and 6), income tariff (Art. 50), wealth tariff, deductions (Art. 39 to 48), source tax and NOV (Art. 105 ff., 112bis, 112ter, 122a, 186), filing duties (Art. 163ter, 168).
notes: 131 pages, version id 3822 (Erlassdatum 07.10.2025). The API JSON at gesetzessammlung.sg.ch/api/de/texts_of_law/811.1 lists all versions; the app page is a JS shell. Version ids change when a new Nachtrag is published.

title: Steuergesetz vom 9. April 1998 (sGS 811.1), Stand 1. Januar 2025
why_needed: Version of the tax law that governs tax year 2025 (in force 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2025).
notes: 131 pages, version id 3711, listed in the API as Fassung in Vollzug von 01.01.2025 bis 31.12.2025 (Erlassdatum 24.11.2024). Earlier 2025 versions 3689 and 3596 were informal corrections.

title: Steuerverordnung vom 20. Oktober 1998 (sGS 811.11), Stand 1. Januar 2024
why_needed: Implementing ordinance: definitions of children (Art. 30), source-tax procedure (Art. 57 ff.), valuation and other details referenced by the guide and the Steuerbuch.
notes: 38 pages, version id 3565, current version in force since 01.01.2024; no newer or scheduled version listed by the API on 2026-10-13, so it applies to 2025 and 2026.

title: Quellensteuer für ausländische Arbeitnehmer (ohne Niederlassungsbewilligung), Tarif A, Monatstarif für Alleinstehende, Stand 1. Januar 2025
why_needed: 2025 monthly source-tax table for single people; tariffs B, C, G, H and capital benefits are in the same folder.
notes: 25 pages, cover says Stand 1. Januar 2025 (PDF modified 17 Dec 2024). Berechnungs_Grundlagen_2025_SG.pdf in the same folder was also opened (tariff codes A, B, C, H and their built-in deductions); B, C, G and H 2025 are listed on the index page.

title: Quellensteuer für ausländische Arbeitnehmer (ohne Niederlassungsbewilligung), Tarif A, Monatstarif für Alleinstehende, Stand 1. Januar 2026
why_needed: 2026 monthly source-tax table for single people, valid from 1 Jan 2026.
notes: 25 pages, created 15 Dec 2025, cover says Stand 1. Januar 2026. The 2026 files sit in a folder named 20251 (sic). Tarif B 2026, Tarif C 2026 and Berechnungsgrundlagen 2026 SG in the same folder were also opened (PDF, same Stand); G and H are listed on the index page.

title: Quellensteuer (Formulare, Merkblätter und Tarife)
why_needed: Index of all source-tax tariffs by year (2022 to 2026: A, B, C, G, H, capital benefits, Berechnungsgrundlagen), NOV request forms and Grenzgänger forms.
notes: Page updated 03.03.2026. Use it to find tariffs B, C, G and H, which are not listed one by one in this manifest.

title: Quellensteuer: Häufig gestellte Fragen
why_needed: States the NOV rules: request by 31 March of the following year, irrevocable once filed, kept until the end of source-tax liability for residents; no more corrections for extra deductions since 2021, NOV instead.
notes: Page updated 03.03.2026. Cites the federal QStV articles; links both NOV forms. Also covers employer correction deadline (end of March) and German cross-border commuters.

title: 51.1.13a Antrag auf nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung für quellensteuerpflichtige Personen mit steuerrechtlichem Wohnsitz oder Aufenthalt in der Schweiz
why_needed: Request form for NOV for source-taxed residents (Art. 112ter StG), sent to the Kantonales Steueramt, Quellensteuer, Davidstrasse 41, St.Gallen.
notes: 2 pages, last modified Dec 2020, still the form linked from the FAQ in 2026. The non-resident version (quasi-resident, Art. 122a StG) is SG_51-1-13b_Antrag-Veranlagung_Nicht-Ansaessige-Quest_def_.pdf in the same folder, also checked.

title: E-Tax SG für Privatpersonen
why_needed: Official page of the online filing app E-Tax SG (etax.sg.ch): E-Login with AGOV, no desktop version from 2025, third-party access by register number and access code or by sharing, upload limits, version history, demo environment.
notes: Page updated 22.09.2026. Version history from 1.0.3 (01.01.2026) to 1.1.18 (24.08.2026). The app itself (etax.sg.ch) is a JavaScript shell and cannot be fetched as content. Help articles are hosted on sg-support.etax.ch (see NOTES).

title: Faltblatt zur Steuererklärung 2025: Steuererklärung jetzt online!
why_needed: Flyer mailed with the 2025 return: E-Tax SG replaces the download software, E-Login via AGOV access app, receipts via the Snapshare app, live chat support.
notes: 2 pages, created 23 Oct 2025, signed by the head of the Finanzdepartement. Steps to register for E-Login in five steps.

title: StB 161 Nr. 1: Fristen
why_needed: Practice on deadlines: the return deadline is an authority deadline that can be extended on a timely request, electronically via steuern.sg.ch; legal deadlines cannot be extended.
notes: 5 pages, Stand 01.01.2016 (PDF modified 2019). States no fee and no latest extension date. The online extension page adds that an extension is only granted if due tax bills are paid.

title: 15. Nachtrag zum Steuerbuch, Stand 1. Januar 2026 (Liste geänderte und neue Weisungen)
why_needed: Lists which Steuerbuch Weisungen changed on 1 Jan 2026 (cantonal multiplier, expense allowances and commuting mileage rate, property costs, interest rates).
notes: 1 page, dated by PDF creation 16 Jan 2026. Use it to know which StB chapters are current; the Steuerbuch index is at sg.ch/steuern-finanzen/steuern/steuerbuch/inhaltsverzeichnis.html. This link is a page attachment path and may change with the next Nachtrag.

title: Neue Online-Steuererklärung E-Tax SG (Medienmitteilung)
why_needed: Official announcement of E-Tax SG for tax period 2025 and of the legal changes: higher commuting cap from 2025, higher federal car mileage rate from 2026, lower Ausgleichszins from 2026, retroactive pillar 3a purchases from tax period 2026.
notes: Published 14.01.2026 09:30. Mentions support hours of the E-Gov support and live chat during the filing season.
